en: Abnormal fluctuations in the magnetic field were detected in the Earth's inner layers.
To counter this unknown crisis, Dr. Saotome developed a new super robot, "Getter Robo".
In search of a new pilot, the Getter Team heads for "Hayato's school".
Episode 2: "Our Time Has Come! The Dinosaur Empire"
The Getter Team had gained a new Getter pilot, "Hayato Jin".
To analyze the true nature of the "enemy", they were at the Saotome Institute on Mt. Asama.
New Getter Robos, built to counter the "Dinosaur Empire", were undergoing operational tests.
The Getter Team headed for the production plant to take delivery of them.
A mysterious new Mechasaurus suddenly appeared.
On receiving the news, the Getter Team rushed to the city, bringing their new power, "Getter Robo G".
Having detected countless high-energy readings, the Getter Team began moving out over the Pacific Ocean to investigate.
A new enemy stands in humanity's way: the "Hyakki Empire".
The Getter Team was heading for the Tachibana Institute to join up with "Getter Robo Go", the new force built to counter it, and its new pilots.
While the team was defending the Tachibana Institute, a distress signal was sent out from the Saotome Institute.
With so few forces, the Getter Team cannot afford to split them up; it must choose one of the two and go to its rescue.
Which one will you rescue?\n  1. Tachibana Institute\n  2. Saotome Institute
In the midst of the battle at the Tachibana Institute, the Saotome Institute comes under attack by the Hyakki Empire at the same time.
But sensing a trap, the Getter Team leaves the Saotome Institute's defense to the base forces there and carries on defending the Tachibana Institute.
In the midst of the battle at the Tachibana Institute, the Saotome Institute comes under attack by the Hyakki Empire at the same time.
Leaving the remaining Hyakki Beasts to the base forces, the Getter Team heads off to rescue the Saotome Institute.
Having temporarily evacuated because of the explosion and the release of Getter Rays, the Getter Team heads back to the Tachibana Institute to see how things stand.
Having temporarily evacuated because of the explosion and the release of Getter Rays, the Getter Team heads back to the Saotome Institute to see how things stand.
To bring down the Hyakki Empire, the nations of the world pooled their military strength and formed the Allied Forces.
The Getter Team, too, had joined up with the Allied Forces at America Base.
To find out what the mysterious beam fired from the skies above really was, the Allied Forces boarded the Kujira and headed for the stratosphere.
Having destroyed the satellite, the Getter Team returned to the Texas.
They should have felt relieved, but having witnessed the power of Shin Getter Robo with their own eyes, they were torn between hope and unease.
Episode 11: "The Last Day of the Hyakki Empire"
The Getter Team returned to the Texas once again.
The Allied Forces were winning victory after victory, but the shadow of a giant enemy was closing in on them.
Through the final power of Burai, and of Uzahra, the Earth's environment is drastically transformed.
Before a land left ravaged and desolate, a new battle was about to begin.
And standing in the Allied Forces' way: Sho Tachibana's older brother, "Shinichi Tachibana".
Now, the Texas was about to be steeped in sorrow...
Every one of the Getter Robos had been forced through fierce battle after fierce battle.
The damage had built up and grown worse than anyone had imagined.
So Dr. Saotome returns to the Institute for a while to carry out large-scale maintenance.
With the Getter Robos' maintenance complete, the Getter Team rejoined the Allied Forces.
Even as this went on, nations around the world had begun fighting Lando's army and were being hard-pressed.
Germany, Russia and Britain in particular, facing powerful enemies, had sent distress signals to the Allied Forces.
As the flames of war spread across the globe, the Allied Forces throw themselves into the thick of the fighting.

Which country will you aid?
  1. Germany
  2. Russia
  3. Britain
The Allied Forces set out to aid nations worldwide and quell the growing war.
A huge black storm cloud suddenly formed in the skies over Germany.
This freak storm cloud is spawning one large tornado after another and destroying the city.
The German government dispatches a special investigation unit in response, but the unit vanishes without a trace.
On receiving the call for help, the Allied Forces took on the task of investigating the storm cloud.
Lando's army invaded the Russian plains, targeting a nuclear missile launch base.
The Allied Forces rushed to help, but the Russian army had already suffered devastating damage and been driven back to its last line of defense.
An abnormal rise in sea level submerged a British city, and at the same time a vast horde of enemies, believed to be Metal Beasts, appeared.
Facing disaster, the British government sent a request for help to the Allied Forces.

The colossal mothership of Lando's army, the "Dragon Turtle", began its advance on Alaska Base, the Allied Forces' stronghold.
Taking the Texas into battle, the Allied Forces throw everything they have into stopping it.
Crushed on the Alaska front and driven into a desperate position, Lando's army makes its move to challenge the Allied Forces to a final, decisive battle.
Lando gathered all his forces in the Arctic Circle, and even began to set his unfinished ultimate weapon, "Vega Zone", in motion.
The Allied Forces, too, sent their entire strength to the Arctic Circle to put an end to this war.
To defeat the Insect Army, the Getter Team at last heads out into space.
However, the other nations' super robots could not operate in space for long, so they were unable to take part in this battle.
Without that valuable fighting strength, the Getter Emperor was heading for the Moon.
The Getter Emperor finally reached the lunar surface.
With "Shin Getter Dragon", born through a dramatic evolution, the Getter Team challenges the Insect Army to a final battle.
